rubric.judge: Direct review by the Codex assistant; no judge model or metric LLM.
rubric.ragas.context_precision: RAGAS-style average precision evaluated separately for each retrieval-query leg, then averaged across legs. Reset rank at each query and de-duplicate identical filename/text chunks within that leg, so a corrective leg is not treated as if it were appended below the initial ranking. The hand-labeled expected_source documents define relevance. Use 0 for a leg with no expected-source context.
rubric.ragas.context_recall: Fraction of hand-labeled expected_source documents represented anywhere in the retrieval trace.
rubric.ragas.faithfulness: Fraction of factual claims in the actual answer supported by the retrieval trace. Use 1 for an answer containing no unsupported factual claims and 0 for a wrong abstention on an answerable case.
rubric.deepeval.answer_correctness: Fraction of required expected-answer facts stated correctly, with unsupported or contradictory additions reducing the score.
rubric.deepeval.hallucination_rate: Fraction of actual-answer factual claims that are unsupported by or contradict the retrieved evidence. Lower is better.
rubric.deepeval.citation_accuracy: Fraction of factual claims whose adjacent filename citations point to passages that support those claims. Missing required citations score 0.
rubric.custom.abstention_accuracy: Binary: 1 when an unanswerable case abstains, or an adversarial case refuses, corrects the false premise, or flags and ignores an injection as expected; else 0.

retrieval_trace.text: Health Checks The backend direct health check is curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health. The Nginx-routed health check is curl http://127.0.0.1/api/health. If the backend direct health check works but the Nginx-routed health check returns 404, the Nginx site is probably not linked, the default site is still enabled, or Nginx was not reloaded. If SSH times out, check the instance state, public IPv4 address, route table, network ACL, and security group source IP. If SSH reports bad key permissions on Windows, move the PEM file to the .ssh folder and restrict file access to the current Windows user. Operational Commands View API logs with sudo journalctl -u agentic-crag-api -f. View UI logs with sudo journalctl -u agentic-crag-ui -f. Validate Nginx config with sudo nginx -t before reloading Nginx. Update the deployed application with cd /opt/agentic-crag/app followed by bash deploy/update_app.sh. Stop the instance when not demonstrating the project to reduce cost. Runbook-Specific Facts The canonical EC2 storage path for this demo is /opt/agentic-crag/data. The canonical public web port is 80, not 8501. The canonical backend port is 8000, but it should only bind to localhost. The canonical UI port is 8501, but it should only bind to localhost. The intended service names are agentic-crag-api and agentic-crag-ui.

Source snippets were not yet exposed to the UI. Version 2.2 supported PDF, DOCX, and XLSX uploads. Version 2.4 added a retrieval debugging endpoint named POST /retrieve. The endpoint returns source snippets without calling the language model. Version 2.4 updated Streamlit to display source snippets in a Sources expander under assistant responses. Version 2.4 added regression coverage for source formatting behavior. Version 2.4 did not add reranking or hybrid BM25 search because the deployment target was a small EC2 instance and the goal was minimal code. Compatibility Notes Collections built before a chunking or embedding change should be rebuilt to ensure retrieval uses the current settings. Changing from Groq to a local Ollama model can alter answer style, even when the same base model family is used. Groq model name llama-3.1-8b-instant refers to a hosted serving configuration. The closest local Ollama model family is llama3.1:8b, but outputs may differ.

The repository should be cloned to /opt/agentic-crag/app. The systemd services expect the virtual environment at /opt/agentic-crag/app/venv. Inbound HTTP on port 80 may be opened to 0.0.0.0/0 for a temporary demo, but the instance should be stopped or locked down after use. The EC2 instance should not expose FastAPI port 8000 or Streamlit port 8501 directly to the public internet. Nginx should be the public entry point. For a longer-lived deployment, add HTTPS, a domain name, and authentication before sharing the application broadly. Setup Commands The recommended initial package command is: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y python3 python3-venv nginx git. A small instance may need a swap file. The demo runbook uses a 2 GB swap file at /swapfile to reduce dependency installation failures. After cloning the repository, run bash deploy/setup_ec2.sh from /opt/agentic-crag/app for repeatable setup. After editing /opt/agentic-crag/.env, restart the application services with sudo systemctl restart agentic-crag-api agentic-crag-ui.
